value.title: 系统 / 数学计算类
value.remarks: 提供多边形几何计算方法，支持离散点坐标和 {@link TPCB_PolygonSourceArray} 多边形数据

methods.name: containsPoint
methods.comment: 判断点是否在多边形内部

methods.name: distanceToPoint
methods.comment: 计算点到多边形边界的最短距离

methods.name: intersects
methods.comment: 判断两个多边形是否相交

methods.name: contains
methods.comment: 判断 polygon1 是否完全包含 polygon2

methods.name: getBBox
methods.comment: 获取多边形的最小外接矩形（BBox）

methods.name: bboxIntersects
methods.comment: 快速判断两个 BBox 是否相交

methods.name: union
methods.comment: 计算两个多边形的并集

methods.name: subtract
methods.comment: 计算两个多边形的差集（polygon1 - polygon2）

methods.name: intersection
methods.comment: 计算两个多边形的交集

methods.name: xor
methods.comment: 计算两个多边形的对称差集（异或）
